title: Sheafification of abelian groups and rings is computed on underlying sheaves of sets
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $P$ be a presheaf of abelian groups (resp. of commutative rings) on $\mathcal C$, with sheafification $\eta:P\to P^\#$ in sheaves of abelian groups (resp. of commutative rings) [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Write $|-|$ for the underlying presheaf of sets. Then $|P^\#|$ is a sheaf of sets and $|\eta|:|P|\to|P^\#|$ is a sheafification of the presheaf of sets $|P|$: every morphism of presheaves of sets from $|P|$ to a sheaf of sets factors uniquely through $|\eta|$.
